rows.en: Ai: "Whaaat?! No way!"
Aurelie: "Oh, he might not care much about that sort of thing."
Ai: "But isn't that more like Fain or Clovis?
Oh! And Touya too!"
Kasumi: "Huh? But Touya-chan wears boxers..."
Ai: "Huh...? Kasumi, you've seen them?"
Celica: "Does that mean...?"
Aurelie: "What?! You two have that kind of relationship?!"
Kasumi: "Huh? What do you mean by 'that kind of
relationship'?"
Celica: "..."
Aurelie: "...Is she serious?"
Ai: "Yes. Probably."
Kasumi: "???"
Touya: "Oh, all 4 of you. What are you doing?"
Ai: "Oh, speak of the devil..."
Aurelie: "If it isn't Touya, the boxer man."
Touya: "W-What?! H-How do you know...? Oh!
Kasumi, you..."
Kasumi: "Huh?! Oh, um... It slipped out..."
Ai: "Now, now, never mind that. The question is Arthur.
What kind of underwear do you think Arthur wears?"
Touya: "What?!"
Yamato: "What kind of conversation is this...?"
Celica: "Well, somehow the conversation just
ended up here..."
Ai: "I'd say there's an 87% chance he wears briefs.
Leopard print, with gold trim, too."
Aurelie: "I'm telling you, that type doesn't wear them."
Celica: "Huh? Then what does he do?"
Aurelie: "A supporter, obviously.
The wrestler type."
Celica: "'Wrestler'? Hmm..."
Kasumi: "..."
Touya: "...What's so funny about that?"
Ai: "Shut up! A maiden is curious about all kinds
of things!"
Touya: "But you... Arthur's..."
Arthur: "What about me?"
Celica: "Oh! A-Arthur?!"
Yamato: "Perfect timing. Why not ask him directly?"
Aurelie: "Well, yes, but... You know, this kind of thing
is most fun when everyone's just chatting about it..."
Ai: "R-Right. Sometimes hearing the answer
takes all the fun out of it."
Celica: "Yeah, that happens."
Touya: "You're embarrassed to ask him directly, aren't you?"
Arthur: "?"
Yamato: "Arthur, these girls were talking about what sort of underwear
you wear."
Arthur: "O-Oh... I see. So that's what it was.
Well... I prefer silk."
Ai: "T-That's unexpected..."
Aurelie: "Silk, huh..."
Celica: "Silk is that shiny, pretty stuff?
Oh... So that's what it is..."
Arthur: "Huh? Is that strange?"
Ai: "Not strange, but... Right?"
Aurelie: "Hmm. Arthur, I always pictured you as a poor, hardworking
student, so..."
Arthur: "Yes, I am. My family isn't especially
wealthy. Though I never felt I had a hard life."
Kasumi: "Huh? But isn't silk expensive...?"
Arthur: "If you buy it normally, yes."
Ai: "Huh? You know your way around the black market too, Arthur?
That's surprising in its own way..."
Arthur: "No. A friend of my father's works in trade.
Years ago, for some reason, he sent us a huge amount
of fabric.
I'm sure he was trying to help in his own way.
Even if we didn't use it, selling it would've brought in quite a sum."
Kasumi: "Did you sell it?"
Arthur: "No. We gave more than half away,
but I felt awkward about turning it into money... So
my mother made undershirts and underwear with the remaining fabric."
Ai: "And that's how you started wearing it? That's an unusual reason."
Arthur: "Perhaps it is."
Ai: "I've never worn silk, so
I wouldn't know. Is it really that good?"
Arthur: "There's a reason it remains
so popular. To explain that, I must start with
what silk actually is."
Aurelie: 'Oh, trouble...'
Celica: 'What's wrong?'
Aurelie: 'Arthur's long lecture has begun.
We'll make our escape when the moment's right.'
Aurelie: "Now!"
Celica: "Yes! Oh, look at the time!
Sorry, I have maintenance to do!"
Aurelie: "Y-Yes. We'd better be going!"
Celica: "You too, Kasumi-chan. Right?"
Kasumi: "Huh? O-Oh..."
Ai: "...Touya, I'll leave the rest to you. Bye!"
Touya: "H-Hey! Oh, well, I'd better be going too..."
Arthur: "What are you saying? Touya, you still
don't understand how wonderful this silk is.
Fain: "Oh, isn't this Touya and Arthur?
I thought I just heard the princess..."
Yamato: 'Touya, this is our chance!'
Touya: 'Y-Yeah...'
Fain: "? Hey, where are you going? Hey?!"
Touya: "Whew. We got away."
Yamato: "At this rate, he'll go all the way back to Chinese history.
Fain, your sacrifice won't be in vain..."
Touya: "...Let's take a little peek..."
Arthur: "...Well, 'silk' covers a wide range,
from inexpensive kinds to very costly ones.
Personally, I can't recommend the cheap varieties.
Fain: "..."
Arthur: "Oh, when did Fain take your place?
...Well, no matter. I'll help you understand
what silk really is, too."
Fain: "N-No, I..."
Arthur: "Now, let's begin with the history of China..."
Touya: "W-Well, we'd better go."
Yamato: "Y-Yes..."
